source.paraphrase: The $env/static/private and $env/dynamic/private modules are server-only. A universal load file that imports them leaks secrets into the client bundle.

invariants.why: Universal load code ships to the browser, and its imports ship with it, so a private-env import publishes the secret it was meant to protect.
invariants.fixHint: Read private env in +page.server.ts or +layout.server.ts and return only the derived public data.
invariants.avoid: A lazy import() of the private module still bundles it. Reading through $env/dynamic/private instead of static is the same leak.

source.paraphrase: Load receives a fetch that talks to the app itself. An absolute http(s) URL pins one origin, so same-app data uses a relative path.

invariants.why: A hardcoded origin breaks previews, branches and region failover: the deployment serving the page is not the origin in the string.
invariants.fixHint: Fetch a relative path such as /api/orders so the request stays on the serving origin.
invariants.avoid: Building the absolute URL in a template string still hardcodes the origin. Interpolating params into the path does not fix the host.

source.paraphrase: Whatever a load function returns is serialized and sent to the client. Tokens and secrets must stay server-side and never appear in the returned object.

invariants.why: Load data crosses the server-client boundary by design, so a secret-shaped field in the return value is published to every visitor.
invariants.fixHint: Use the secret server-side (sessions, API calls) and return only the derived public result such as the user profile.
invariants.avoid: Nesting the token one level down still serializes it. Renaming the field hides the leak from review, not from the client.

relations.why: SK-ERROR-001 tells load functions to throw error(500, ...) with a static message, and TS-THROW-001 denies that throw inside the exported load.
relations.settle: On SvelteKit 2 call error(...) without the throw keyword: it throws itself and no throw statement remains. On SvelteKit 1, exclude the **/+page.server.ts, **/+layout.server.ts and **/+server.ts route files from TS-THROW-001.

source.paraphrase: error() renders its message to the client. Passing err.message forwards internal detail, so unexpected failures get a static message while the original is logged.

invariants.why: Raw error messages carry paths, query fragments and driver detail that help an attacker map the backend.
invariants.fixHint: Log the original error server-side and throw error(500, ...) with a static message the user can act on.
invariants.avoid: Concatenating err.message onto a static prefix still sends it. Interpolating it into a template still sends it.
